exposure: Open entry for laparoscopic single-site surgery
cohort: A 37-year-old woman with a history of dysmenorrhea and a C/S wound defect undergoing laparoscopic single-site myomectomy and repair of the C/S wound defect was the subject of this case report.
finding: This case report describes a rare complication of gastric serosal injury during open entry for laparoscopic surgery when the stomach is distended, suggesting prevention through nasopharyngeal tube insertion and abdominal percussion.
